note: Daily feed of popular postings for /try, varied across fields (tech, finance/IB, quant, product, data/business analyst, marketing) and across seniority - Mehek: not just SWE. SENIORITY MIX IS REQUIRED (2026-07-27): this feed was intern-only, which made the one demo a visitor can actually run read as a product built solely for students. Litos serves students, but not only students. Each refresh should carry roughly half open-level or mid-level roles and at most half internship or new-grad roles, and must never be all of one. Regenerated by the try-jobs-refresh task: pull ~10 recent, recognizable roles across that seniority mix, spread the titles, write the full real JD text into `jd`, and make applyUrl the real, verified-live application URL. Note (2026-07-15, predates the seniority rule): mid-summer, so most Summer-2026 intern reqs are closed and Summer-2027 large-tech reqs have not opened yet; the currently-open intern universe skews to early-recruiting trading firms plus a handful of fintech/consumer roles. No US investment-banking summer-analyst intern was verifiable-live this week, so finance is represented by intern-level quant/trading roles.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (Fall 2026)
jobs.jd: Software Engineering Intern (Fall 2026), New York. Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. As a software engineering intern you will work alongside full-time engineers to build and ship features on a live, publicly traded crypto platform. We look for students pursuing a CS or related degree with strong fundamentals in data structures and algorithms and hands-on project experience in a modern language.

jobs.title: Campus Software Engineer (Intern)
jobs.jd: Campus Software Engineer (Intern), Chicago. Jump Trading Group empowers exceptional talent in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to push scientific boundaries and apply cutting-edge research to global financial markets. As a software engineering intern you will design, develop, and deploy real technologies alongside experienced engineers in a fast-paced, research-driven, and intensely collaborative environment. Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and a modern programming language are expected.

jobs.title: 2027 Software Engineer Intern
jobs.location: Costa Mesa, CA / Seattle, WA / Boston, MA / Atlanta, GA / Reston, VA / Irvine, CA

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company building advanced autonomy, AI, computer vision, and sensor-fusion systems, powered by its Lattice OS that turns thousands of data streams into a real-time command and control center. As a software engineering intern you will own real projects alongside full-time engineers building software that powers Anduril's family of systems. jobs.title: Summer 2027 Quantitative Research Internship
jobs.jd: Summer 2027 Quantitative Research Internship, New York, with Cubist Systematic Strategies, an affiliate of Point72. Cubist deploys systematic, computer-driven trading strategies across multiple liquid asset classes including equities, futures, and foreign exchange, fueled by rigorous research into a wide range of market anomalies. Interns partner with researchers on a project applying statistics and machine learning to large financial datasets. Strong programming in Python and solid probability and statistics fundamentals are expected; applications are considered for all similar positions at Cubist.

jobs.title: Quantitative Research Intern (BS/MS), Summer 2027
jobs.jd: Quantitative Research Intern (BS/MS), Summer 2027, Chicago. This 10-week internship is your chance to experience life as a Quant Researcher at IMC: you will work alongside a mentor to explore new research ideas and build custom analysis tools that may be deployed into production. Throughout the summer you will deepen your knowledge of options theory, market making, algorithm complexity, and trade analysis. Interns who meet performance expectations may earn an offer for a full-time Graduate Quant Researcher role; the program offers highly competitive compensation with accommodation included.

jobs.title: Campus Quantitative Trader (Intern)
jobs.jd: Campus Quantitative Trader (Intern), Chicago or New York. Jump Trading Group applies cutting-edge research to global financial markets in a culture built on fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. As a quantitative trader intern you will learn to analyze markets, manage risk, and develop and test trading ideas alongside experienced traders and researchers. Strong quantitative aptitude, comfort with probability and statistics, and programming ability are expected.

jobs.title: Product Management Intern (Fall 2026)
jobs.jd: Product Management Intern (Fall 2026), New York. jobs.title: Product Analyst Intern (Spring/Summer 2026)

You will gain hands-on experience in data-driven product analysis and commercialization strategy, exposure to SaaS and DaaS product management processes, and mentorship from experienced product and strategy professionals while contributing to live business initiatives.

jobs.title: Data Science Intern
jobs.jd: Data Science Intern, San Francisco. As a data science intern you will work with data and machine learning to build insights and tools that help level the playing field for local retailers. We look for students with strong statistics and programming fundamentals (Python/SQL) and hands-on data project experience.
